name: Background job queue
description: Adds a durable job queue and a standalone worker process, so slow or unreliable work (sending mail, calling a third party) never blocks a request. Needs a persistence layer already present — either the nextjs-postgres stack pack or the standalone db capability pack — but v1's requiresPacks is identity-based ("needs pack X"), not capability-based ("needs something providing persistence"), so that dependency cannot be machine-checked yet; see templates/pack.tpl.json's note on this.

inputs.name: concurrency
inputs.description: Max jobs the worker processes at once.

generatedArtifacts.description: enqueue() and job-definition helpers used by API routes and other packs.
Standalone worker process entrypoint — runs as its own container/process, not inside the web server.

verification.description: Enqueues a job against a real queue backend and asserts the worker actually processes it, not just that enqueue() resolves.

operationalEvidence.evidence: Every job logs enqueue, start, success/failure and retry count as structured events, so a stuck queue is diagnosable from logs alone.
The worker process exposes its own liveness/readiness check, separate from the web process's /api/health — a stalled worker does not read as a healthy deployment.
